name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2001, Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited is engaged in the business of energy transition equipment and power technologies.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile [1]
Quality Power Electrical Equipment Limited is an Indian manufacturer serving global clients in the critical energy transition equipment and power technologies sector. The company provides high-voltage electrical equipment and solutions for electrical grid connectivity and energy transition, specializing in power generation, transmission, distribution, and automation sectors.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 12.3 times its book value
Earnings include an other income of Rs.57.8 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 113 to 149 days.
Working capital days have increased from 31.7 days to 122 days
